proposal.author: Astra design agent, fixed before evaluation
proposal.kind: one composite analytic intervention across three layers
proposal.rule: Repurpose first hidden unit to tanh(ball row minus paddle row); relay via tanh; add opposite up/down steering head coefficients.
proposal.revision_note: Follow-up after failed first proposal: bias toward stay at equal rows and stronger directional steering.
proposal.limitation: Embeds a hand-specified Pong tracking heuristic; multiple parameter coordinates change. This is not a discovered task-agnostic latent edit.

notes: Fixed analytic game-aware heuristic; no training-seed selection or calibration.
Each seed uses one fixed cohort; terminal episodes are counted once, without resetting or completion-order selection.
Random edits match changed-coordinate support and per-tensor update norm; they are not generic random policies.
Latency is warm CPU inference only. Timing differences are noisy; architecture and parameter count are identical.
Reported standard errors describe episodes, not independent seed-level uncertainty.
